paragraphs.s: GRAMMAR: LINKING EXPRESSIONS
paragraphs.tr: 语法：连接表达。

ana.frame: 小标题：GRAMMAR: LINKING EXPRESSIONS（语法：连接表达）
gram: linking expression 连接词、衔接语
ana.tip: 连接词是 Part 4 的第二把钥匙：看上下句的逻辑关系。

paragraphs.s: B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with expressions that link sentences.
paragraphs.tr: B1 Preliminary 的考生经常在连接句子的表达上出错。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：B1 Preliminary candidates often make mistakes with expressions that link sentences.
parts: with expressions that link sentences —— 在连接句子的表达上
ana.tip: 转折、结果、递进 —— 每种关系都有固定的信号词。

paragraphs.s: ② Choose the correct word or phrase in these sentences.
paragraphs.tr: ② 选出这些句子里正确的词或短语。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Choose the correct word or phrase in these sentences.
parts: the correct word or phrase —— 正确的词或短语
in these sentences —— 在这些句子里
ana.tip: 先判断两句之间的逻辑关系，再选连接词。

paragraphs.s: We decided not to buy that car because it was too big. Another/Other reason was that it was too expensive.
paragraphs.tr: 我们决定不买那辆车，因为它太大。另一个原因是它太贵。

ana.frame: 主谓宾 + 原因：Another reason was that it was too expensive.
parts: We decided not to buy that car because it was too big —— 我们因为车太大决定不买
that it was too expensive —— 它太贵
clauses: because 原因从句；that 表语从句
gram: another + 单数名词 另一个
ana.tip: reason 是单数名词 → another（另一个）。官方：1 Another。

paragraphs.s: It was the middle of the night. Although/In spite of that, the streets were crowded with people.
paragraphs.tr: 那是半夜。尽管如此，街上还是挤满了人。

ana.frame: 让步：____ that, the streets were crowded with people.
parts: It was the middle of the night —— 那是半夜
In spite of that —— 尽管如此
were crowded with people —— 挤满了人
gram: in spite of + 名词（that 指前句）；although + 从句
ana.tip: 后面是 that（名词性），不是从句 → In spite of。官方：2 In spite of。

note.cn: 尽管（+ 名词/动名词，不跟从句）

paragraphs.s: There was writing on the wall of the cave. What/Which it said was impossible to read.
paragraphs.tr: 洞穴墙上有字。上面写的是什么没法看清。

ana.frame: 主语从句：____ it said was impossible to read.
parts: There was writing on the wall of the cave —— 洞壁上有字
was impossible to read —— 没法看清
gram: what 引导主语从句（which 需有选择范围）
ana.tip: 「它说的内容」没有选择范围 → What。官方：3 What。

note.cn: 什么（引导主语/宾语从句）

paragraphs.s: The morning was sunny and hot. So/However, in the afternoon it became cold and wet.
paragraphs.tr: 早上又晴又热。然而，下午变得又冷又湿。

ana.frame: 转折：____, in the afternoon it became cold and wet.
parts: The morning was sunny and hot —— 早上又晴又热
gram: however 然而（前后对比）；so 表结果
ana.tip: 晴热 ↔ 冷湿是对比 → However。官方：4 However。

note.cn: 然而（转折副词，后面加逗号）

paragraphs.s: Our plan was to get to the station early, but we missed the train. Also/Instead, we went by bus.
paragraphs.tr: 我们本打算早点到车站，但错过了火车。于是我们改坐巴士。

ana.frame: 替代：____, we went by bus.
parts: Our plan was to get to the station early, but we missed the train —— 本想早到但错过火车
gram: instead 反而、改为（单独用）；instead of + 名词
ana.tip: 火车没赶上 → 改为坐巴士 → Instead。官方：5 Instead。

note.cn: 反而，代替（单独用；instead of + 名词）

paragraphs.s: We'd better get some food. Therefore/Otherwise, we'll be hungry later.
paragraphs.tr: 我们最好弄点吃的。否则，等会儿会饿。

ana.frame: 否则：____, we'll be hungry later.
parts: We'd better get some food —— 最好弄点吃的
'll be hungry later —— 等会儿会饿
gram: otherwise 否则（= if not）；therefore 因此
ana.tip: 「不弄吃的 → 就会饿」是反面条件 → Otherwise。官方：6 Otherwise。

paragraphs.s: FOCUS: USING SYNONYMS AND LINKING EXPRESSIONS AS CLUES
paragraphs.tr: 重点：用同义词和连接词当线索。

ana.frame: 小标题：FOCUS: USING SYNONYMS AND LINKING EXPRESSIONS AS CLUES
parts: USING SYNONYMS AND LINKING EXPRESSIONS —— 用同义词和连接词
ana.tip: 选句题：上一句的同义词和连接词告诉你下一句该接什么。

paragraphs.s: ③ Match sentences 1–3 with sentences A–D to form a complete paragraph. There's one sentence which you don't need to use. Look for synonyms and linking expressions to help you.
paragraphs.tr: ③ 把句子 1–3 与 A–D 配成一段完整的段落。有一句你不需要用。找同义词和连接词来帮你。

ana.frame: 祈使句：Match sentences 1–3 with sentences A–D to form a complete paragraph.
parts: Match sentences 1–3 with sentences A–D —— 把 1–3 与 A–D 配对
to form a complete paragraph —— 组成完整段落
There's one sentence which you don't need to use —— 有一句不用
Look for synonyms and linking expressions —— 找同义词和连接词
ana.tip: 答案：1→C / 2→D / 3→A；B 用不上（没有理由句）。

paragraphs.s: 1 Lucas was hoping to spend the morning taking it easy at home.
paragraphs.tr: 1 Lucas 本希望上午在家放松地度过。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Lucas was hoping to spend the morning taking it easy at home.
parts: was hoping to spend —— 希望度过
the morning taking it easy at home —— 上午在家放松地过
ana.tip: 「在家放松」→ C 的 his plans for a relaxing Sunday（他的放松计划）是同义替换。官方：1→C。

paragraphs.s: 2 It was from Jake, who was walking in the countryside, and he sounded worried.
paragraphs.tr: 2 是 Jake 打来的，他正在乡间徒步，听起来很担心。

ana.frame: 主系表：It was from Jake, who was walking in the countryside, and he sounded worried.
parts: was from Jake —— 是 Jake 打来的
who was walking in the countryside —— 正在乡间徒步
and he sounded worried —— 听起来很担心
clauses: who 非限制性定语从句
ana.tip: 「他听起来担心」→ D 的 So Lucas asked him what was wrong（问他怎么了）。官方：2→D。

paragraphs.s: 3 Jake replied that he was by himself in cold, thick fog and was completely lost.
paragraphs.tr: 3 Jake 回答说，他一个人身处又冷又浓的雾里，完全迷路了。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Jake replied that he was by himself in cold, thick fog and was completely lost.
parts: he was by himself in cold, thick fog and was completely lost —— 他独自在浓雾里、完全迷路
ana.tip: 「独自、迷路」→ A 的 his friend out there on his own（朋友独自在外）。官方：3→A。

paragraphs.s: Work in pairs. Highlight the linking expressions, synonyms and reference words that help link each correct sentence A–D with 1–3. Which words tell you why one of them doesn't fit any of 1–3?
paragraphs.tr: 两人一组。标出帮助把 A–D 与 1–3 连起来的连接词、同义词和指代词。哪些词告诉你为什么有一句不适合 1–3 里的任何一句？

ana.frame: 祈使句 + 疑问句：Highlight the linking expressions, synonyms and reference words …
parts: Highlight the linking expressions, synonyms and reference words —— 标出连接词、同义词和指代词
that help link each correct sentence A–D with 1–3 —— 帮助把 A–D 与 1–3 连起来的
Which words tell you why one of them doesn't fit any of 1–3? —— 哪些词说明有一句不适合？
ana.tip: B（That was why he was alone in the hills in winter）没有理由支撑 —— 前文没说「他为什么会在那儿」。

choose the correct answer —— 选出正确答案
There are three extra sentences which you do not need to use —— 有三句多余的不用

ana.tip: 选句三看：看同义词、看连接词、看指代词（it/he/that…）。

paragraphs.s: The story of the carrot and the ring
paragraphs.tr: 胡萝卜和戒指的故事。

ana.frame: 标题：The story of the carrot and the ring（胡萝卜和戒指的故事）
parts: the carrot and the ring —— 胡萝卜和戒指
ana.tip: 预告：胡萝卜和戒指怎么会扯上关系？

paragraphs.s: Have you ever lost something that was precious to you, and thought you'd never see it again?
paragraphs.tr: 你有没有丢过对你来说很珍贵的东西，还以为再也见不到了？

ana.frame: 疑问句：Have you ever lost something that was precious to you …?
parts: Have you ever lost —— 你有没有丢过
something that was precious to you —— 对你很珍贵的东西
and thought you'd never see it again —— 还以为再也见不到它
gram: be precious to sb. 对某人来说很珍贵
ana.tip: 开场提问 —— 引出「失而复得」的主题。

note.cn: 珍贵的（be precious to sb. 对某人来说很珍贵）

paragraphs.s: That's what happened to Mary Grams from Canada.
paragraphs.tr: 这就是加拿大 Mary Grams 遇到的事。

ana.frame: 主系表：That's what happened to Mary Grams from Canada.
parts: what happened to Mary Grams from Canada —— 发生在加拿大 Mary Grams 身上的事
gram: happen to sb. 发生在某人身上
ana.tip: 引出主角 Mary。

note.cn: 发生在某人身上（Sth. happen to sb. 某事情发生在某人身上）

paragraphs.s: Mary had worn her engagement ring for more than half a century when she suddenly lost it.
paragraphs.tr: Mary 的订婚戒指戴了半个多世纪，有一天她突然把它弄丢了。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Mary had worn her engagement ring for more than half a century when she suddenly lost it.
parts: her engagement ring —— 她的订婚戒指
for more than half a century —— 半个多世纪
when she suddenly lost it —— 当她突然弄丢它时
clauses: when 时间从句；过去完成时
ana.tip: 「戴了半个多世纪」—— 戒指很有纪念意义。

paragraphs.s: She was working in her garden on the family farm one day, pulling out a plant. {16}
paragraphs.tr: 有一天她在家里的农场花园里干活，正拔一棵植物。〔16〕

ana.frame: 过去进行时：She was working in her garden on the family farm one day, pulling out a plant.
parts: was working in her garden on the family farm —— 在农场花园里干活
pulling out a plant —— 拔一棵植物
clauses: 过去进行时；现在分词作伴随
ana.tip: 「拔植物」正是掉戒指的瞬间 → 16 选 C（And that was probably when the ring came off her finger）。

paragraphs.s: When she discovered it was missing, she searched everywhere for it for days, before finally giving up.
paragraphs.tr: 当她发现戒指不见了，她到处找了好几天，最后只好放弃。

ana.frame: 主谓：she searched everywhere for it for days, before finally giving up.
parts: When she discovered it was missing —— 当她发现它不见了
searched everywhere for it for days —— 到处找了好几天
before finally giving up —— 在最终放弃之前
ana.tip: 「找了几天、放弃」—— 衬托后面的惊喜。

paragraphs.s: Mary realised she probably wasn't going to find the ring again.
paragraphs.tr: Mary 意识到她大概再也找不回那枚戒指了。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Mary realised she probably wasn't going to find the ring again.
parts: she probably wasn't going to find the ring again —— 她大概再也找不到了
ana.tip: 找不到 → 接下来要想办法。

paragraphs.s: So she decided not to tell anyone about what had happened, apart from her son.
paragraphs.tr: 所以她决定除了儿子，不把这件事告诉任何人。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：she decided not to tell anyone about what had happened, apart from her son.
parts: decided not to tell anyone —— 决定不告诉任何人
apart from her son —— 除了她儿子
ana.tip: 「只告诉儿子」—— 为后文家人不知情埋伏笔。

paragraphs.s: Instead, she thought she would replace it with a much cheaper ring from a jeweller's. {17}
paragraphs.tr: 于是她想，不如去珠宝店买一枚便宜得多的戒指来代替它。〔17〕

ana.frame: 主谓宾：she thought she would replace it with a much cheaper ring from a jeweller's.
parts: she would replace it with a much cheaper ring from a jeweller's —— 用珠宝店买来的便宜戒指替换它
ana.tip: 「买便宜戒指替代」→ 17 选 H（Luckily, she managed to find another one that looked just like it）。

paragraphs.s: In fact, it was so similar that no-one else in her family even knew her original ring was missing.
paragraphs.tr: 事实上，那枚戒指太像了，家里其他人甚至不知道她的原戒指丢了。

ana.frame: 主系表 + 结果：it was so similar that no-one else in her family even knew her original ring was missing.
parts: that no-one else in her family even knew her original ring was missing —— 以至于家里没人知道原戒指丢了
ana.tip: 「太像了」← 指代 H 的 another one（新戒指）。

paragraphs.s: But the story has a happy ending.
paragraphs.tr: 但这个故事有一个快乐的结局。

ana.frame: 主谓宾：But the story has a happy ending.
ana.tip: 转折句 —— 提醒下面要反转了。

paragraphs.s: Mary eventually got her engagement ring back – 13 years after it was lost!
paragraphs.tr: Mary 最终找回了她的订婚戒指——在丢失 13 年之后！

ana.frame: 主谓宾：Mary eventually got her engagement ring back – 13 years after it was lost!
parts: eventually got her engagement ring back —— 最终拿回
her engagement ring —— 她的订婚戒指
13 years after it was lost —— 丢失 13 年后
clauses: after 时间从句；被动语态
ana.tip: 13 年后失而复得 —— 怎么找到的？往下看。

paragraphs.s: One day Mary's daughter-in-law Colleen was working in the same garden where Mary had been all those years ago. {18}
paragraphs.tr: 有一天，Mary 的儿媳 Colleen 在 Mary 多年前待过的同一个花园里干活。〔18〕

ana.frame: 过去进行时：Colleen was working in the same garden where Mary had been all those years ago.

paragraphs.s: But this time it looked a bit different – because there was a carrot growing right through the middle of it!

paragraphs.s: As soon as Colleen saw the ring, she knew immediately who the owner was.
paragraphs.tr: Colleen 一看到戒指，立刻就知道主人是谁。

paragraphs.s: The farm had been in the family for over 100 years. {19}
paragraphs.tr: 这个农场属于这个家族已经超过 100 年。〔19〕

paragraphs.s: So when Colleen discovered the story of the lost ring, it became clear there was only one person it could possibly have belonged to, and the ring was returned to Mary.
paragraphs.tr: 所以当 Colleen 得知丢戒指的故事后，很明显只可能属于一个人，戒指就这样还给了 Mary。

paragraphs.s: Mary decided to remove her ring from the carrot and wear it again. {20}

questions.prompt: 训练②-1 ——「We decided not to buy that car because it was too big. Another/Other reason was that it was too expensive.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 A（Another）。reason 是单数名词 → another（另一个）。官方：1 Another。
others: Other 后面通常接复数名词或不可数名词（other reasons / other information）。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

questions.prompt: 训练②-2 ——「It was the middle of the night. Although/In spite of that, the streets were crowded with people.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 B（In spite of）。空后是 that（名词性指代），不是从句 → In spite of that（尽管如此）。官方：2 In spite of。
others: Although 后面要跟完整的从句（Although it was the middle of the night…），不能直接接 that。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

parts: It was the middle of the night. Although/In spite of that, the streets were crowded with people.

questions.prompt: 训练②-3 ——「There was writing on the wall of the cave. What/Which it said was impossible to read.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 A（What）。「它说的内容」没有选择范围 → What 引导主语从句。官方：3 What。
others: Which 需要「在某个范围里选」，这里没有范围。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

questions.prompt: 训练②-4 ——「The morning was sunny and hot. So/However, in the afternoon it became cold and wet.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 B（However）。晴热 ↔ 冷湿是对比 → However（然而）。官方：4 However。
others: So 表结果：晴热所以变冷湿 —— 逻辑不通。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

parts: The morning was sunny and hot. So/However, in the afternoon it became cold and wet.

questions.prompt: 训练②-5 ——「Our plan was to get to the station early, but we missed the train. Also/Instead, we went by bus.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 B（Instead）。错过火车 → 改为坐巴士 → Instead（改为、反而）。官方：5 Instead。
others: Also 表递进（还、也）—— 但「坐巴士」是替代方案，不是补充。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

questions.prompt: 训练②-6 ——「We'd better get some food. Therefore/Otherwise, we'll be hungry later.」选哪个？
questions.why: 官方答案 B（Otherwise）。「不弄吃的 → 就会饿」是反面条件 → Otherwise（否则）。官方：6 Otherwise。
others: Therefore 表结果（因此）——「弄吃的所以会饿」逻辑不通。
questions.tip: 先判断关系：并列？转折？结果？反面条件？

parts: We'd better get some food. Therefore/Otherwise, we'll be hungry later.

summary.title: 书上批注 · 要点速览

groups.t: 语法 / 讲解（非词组类批注）

items.cn: another 和 other 的区别：① other 可作主语/宾语/定语（作定语时后接复数名词或不可数名词）；作名词时有复数 others（泛指「别人/别的东西」），the other 指「两者中的另一个」，the others 指「其余的全部」。② another 由 an + other 构成，只能代替或修饰「单数可数名词」，前面不再用冠词：Would you like another cup of coffee?（再来一杯咖啡？）

although 和 in spite of 的区别：① although 后面跟从句（Although he was tired, he went on working.）；注意 although 不能用来指「假设的情况」、不能当并列连词、也不能像 however 那样作副词放句尾。② in spite of 后面跟名词或动名词，不跟从句（In spite of her never having acted before, her first performance was excellent.）。

summaryTip: Part 4 的钥匙有两把：同义词（换一种说法）和连接词（However / So / Instead…）；再把 it / he / that 这些指代词顺着读一遍，句子就各归其位。
